Class J2dRayProjectile

be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.j2d.entities.J2dRayProjectile
public class J2dRayProjectile extends RayProjectile
Concrete RayProjectile with Java2D rendering — used for the raygun (ArrowTower) single-target shots. Cannon shots use J2dCannonProjectile instead.

Uses the projectile_ray.png sprite, falling back to a bright yellow circle if the sprite cannot be loaded. The single-target hit behaviour lives in the game-logic superclass RayProjectile.onHit().

    • J2dRayProjectile

      public J2dRayProjectile(Position start, Position target, int damage, J2dGame j2dGame)
      Creates a Java2D ray projectile flying from start to target.
      Parameters:
      start - the position the projectile is fired from
      target - the world position the projectile flies toward
      damage - the damage dealt on direct hit
      j2dGame - the view used for rendering and coordinate conversion

  • Method Details

    • render

      public void render()
      Description copied from class: Entity
      Draws this entity on the screen.

      This method is intentionally left abstract here so that the game-logic package stays free of visualization code. J2d subclasses (e.g. J2dEnemy) override it and use Graphics2D to draw the entity. The game package never imports any visualization library.
